input: Write a Yelp review for my favorite local bookshop

gold.taskTitle: Write a Yelp Review for Your Favorite Bookshop
gold.taskDescription: Write and publish a compelling Yelp review for a local bookshop the user loves.

questions.title: What is the exact name of the bookshop?
questions.description: Identify the specific bookshop to be reviewed by name.

questions.title: What star rating will you give it?
questions.description: Determine the star rating the user intends to leave on Yelp.

questions.title: What specific experience are you writing about?
questions.description: Identify whether the review is about a recent visit, a long-standing relationship, a specific event, or general impressions.

questions.title: Which aspects of the shop do you most want to highlight?
questions.description: Find out what the user values most, such as staff, selection, atmosphere, events, or prices.

questions.title: What tone do you want the review to have?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants the review to feel casual and personal, witty and fun, or formal and detailed.

questions.title: How long should the finished review be?
questions.description: Determine the desired length, such as a short paragraph, a medium review, or a long detailed write-up.

questions.title: Will you post this yourself or do you need help with that too?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user only needs the written review drafted, or also wants guidance on how to post it on Yelp.
